reference_step_rule: median admissible ramp position — positional and therefore OUTCOME-BLIND; the chosen step's ramp value ships beside every excess_ref cell

versioning: F4: a changed extraction rule is a NEW catalog version, never an in-place edit. Sealed claims quote descriptor@version forever.
